format: BB jam-or-fold vs an open, opener call-or-fold. Opener range = the app's RFI chart (input). Blinds 0.5/1, no ante, open 2.5bb (SB 3bb), stack = BB effective stack in bb.
solver: Regret-matching+ with linear averaging over hand classes, Monte Carlo all-in equities (20000 boards per class matchup), exact card-removal pair counts.
